subject: Request: additional evaluation capacity for RFP bake-off vs. Competitor X
messages:
From: Oliver Park <oliver.park@medatech.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medatech.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — extra credits for our benchmark run

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We have a tight window to run a three-day RFP bake-off against Competitor X and our trials hit the token cap. The engineering team needs roughly an additional 200k tokens per model (we're testing two model families) to complete a fair head-to-head evaluation, plus longer retention for logs to review outputs.

Can Redwood provide a short-term uplift or a trial extension so we can finish the runs before the committee meets next Wednesday? We can commit to a short mutual action plan (MVP evaluation script + feedback rundown) in exchange for an accommodation. Attached is the RFP summary and a proposed evaluation plan.

Appreciate any flexibility — Oliver

--
Oliver Park
Lead, Applied AI Evaluation
MedAtech
oliver.park@medatech.com
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Oliver Park <oliver.park@medatech.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — extra credits for our benchmark run

Oliver —

Really appreciate the context and the evaluation plan; looks comprehensive. Short answer: we can support a temporary uplift but I need to confirm two items before I lock numbers in with you:

- Internal approval for a one-off top-up outside of standard trial limits (finance/ops guardrails).
- A quick sign-off on the mutual action plan (MVP eval script + log sharing window) to ensure the uplift is used for the bake-off only.

If those are fine, I can propose a 90k token top-up per model today (total 180k) and a 14-day log retention for the bake-off artifacts. If you still need ~200k per model, I can ask for manager escalation — but heads-up, larger top-ups typically require an ops exemption.

Can you confirm the absolute minimum tokens required per model and whether the evaluation script you attached is final? If so, I'll kick off approval and loop Aditya for sign-off.

Best,
Hannah

Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0184
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — extra credits for our benchmark run

Hannah —

Thanks for the flag. Given MedAtech is a strategic target in healthcare and this is a competitive bake-off, I'm comfortable approving a one-off exception. Approvals:

- Token uplift: approve additional 200k tokens per model (total 400k) for the two model families.
- Retention: approve 21-day logs retention for evaluation artifacts (security note: redact PII per our standard QA checklist).
- Conditions: require signed Mutual Action Plan (MOU-lite) before credits are provisioned, and tag the allocation with deal_id RD-2026-0457 for tracking/billing.

Hannah, please coordinate with Ops to provision immediately after the signed MAP and confirm scope of models/variants. Grace, please add an Ops ticket and ensure the allocation does not violate current quota ceilings for the dedicated pool.

-Aditya

Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Oliver Park <oliver.park@medatech.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medatech.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 23:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick ask — extra credits for our benchmark run

Hannah / Aditya —

Fantastic, thank you both. MedAtech accepts the terms: we'll sign the Mutual Action Plan (MOU-lite) today and confirm the two model families and exact variants by EOD tomorrow. The team appreciates the 21-day retention and the clear tagging with RD-2026-0457.

We'll send the signed MAP and the final eval script within the hour and will track the HubSpot deal for next steps. One small ask from procurement: can you provide a short audit note we can include in our internal binder that states this is a one-time evaluation uplift and not a change to contracted pricing? If that's possible, please cc procurement.

Thanks — Oliver
